Audio audition

Open this file from art/ (the raw clips are read from art/vendor/, the built ones from art/build/audio/). Each sound ID shows the current pick(s) from art/audio.json and the plan's alternates (docs/FX_AUDIO.md). Measurements are of the raw clips: length, audible length (above -50 dB), sample peak, integrated loudness. Tick the clip(s) to use for each sound (several ticked = variants, played round-robin; none ticked = silent). Your ticks are kept in this browser. Then Download picks.json and run node scripts/audio/build-audio.js --apply-picks <path to picks.json> (or send the file to Claude): it writes the ticked clips into art/audio.json as confirmed picks. Then npm run audio:lock, npm run audio:build and npm run audio:audition.
